answer: Glacier-meadow milestone bond: each identity locks 70 credits for 3 milestones. Each milestone assigns a task — survey a glacier melt line or clock the zephyr drift on a meadow — proved by a signed filing. Auditors replay filings on the glacier table; copies burn the bond. Milestones cost 40, 45, 50: one identity pays 135; 1,000 fakes pay 135,000 + 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented filings fail. Honest agents pay 135 once, keep the bond.
